name: Does custom framing impact the resale value of a home?

mainEntity.name: Does custom framing impact the resale value of a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, custom framing can positively impact the resale value of a home. It allows for unique architectural designs, higher ceilings, and specialized layouts that differentiate a property from standard builds. These distinct features often appeal to buyers looking for a unique and high-quality residence, potentially commanding a higher market price compared to homes with more conventional framing and design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom framing can increase resale value by creating unique architectural designs and specialized layouts that appeal to buyers seeking high-quality, distinctive homes.
